query:
-- Find the user and their organization
SELECT u.id, u.email, o.id as org_id, o.credits 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN organizations o ON u.organization_id = o.id 
WHERE u.email = 'sensei@mydojomartialarts.com';

-- Update the organization credits
UPDATE organizations 
SET credits = credits + 50000 
WHERE id = (
  SELECT organization_id FROM users WHERE email = 'sensei@mydojomartialarts.com'
);

-- Verify the update
SELECT u.email, o.credits 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN organizations o ON u.organization_id = o.id 
WHERE u.email = 'sensei@mydojomartialarts.com';
